analysis.summary: Vidya Wires Limited is a manufacturer of winding and conductivity products, currently holding the 4th largest market position in India. The company is undertaking a capacity expansion project to increase production from 19,680 MT to 37,680 MT, aiming to become the 3rd largest manufacturer in the sector. Management is focusing on diversifying its product portfolio into 20 categories and expanding its geographical footprint to drive export growth. The company maintains a de-risked business model with a wide customer base and is actively pursuing deleveraging strategies to reduce interest burdens.
